alerts.title: Big Oak Flat Road (continuation of Hwy 120 from the west) is closed
alerts.description: Big Oak Flat Road (continuation of Highway 120 from the west into Yosemite Valley) is temporarily closed due to snow. We will assess the road and reopen as soon as it is safe. Yosemite is open and reachable via Highways 41 and 140. Tire chains will be required. Call 209/372-0200 (then 1, 1) for road conditions.

alerts.title: Tioga and Glacier Point Roads are closed due snow
alerts.description: Tioga Road (continuation of Highway 120 through the park) and Glacier Point Road are closed for the season. They usually reopen in late May or June, depending on conditions.

alerts.title: Campgrounds and Curry Village tent cabins are closed due to a winter storm
alerts.description: Upper Pines, Camp 4, Wawona, and Hodgdon Meadow Campgrounds, and Curry Village tent cabins, will close on Wednesday, November 18, at 8 am due to risk of high winds and falling trees. We will evaluate conditions on Friday morning.

alerts.title: Tire chains may be required
alerts.description: Carry tire chains in your car and be prepared to use them (even if your car has four-wheel drive): chains may become mandatory at any time. Drive carefully even when there are no chain requirements: you may encounter icy spots on mostly dry roads.

alerts.title: Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road will temporarily close on Oct. 29 at 6 pm
alerts.description: Tioga Road (continuation of Highway 120 through the park) and Glacier Point Road will temporarily close on Thursday, October 29, at 6 pm due to a forecast of snow. Call 209/372-0200 (then 1, 1) to check road conditions in the park.

alerts.title: No overnight parking on Tioga & Glacier Point Roads
alerts.description: Overnight parking is not allowed on Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road, including all parking lots reachable from these roads.
